args.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_csi(p_cntref CHARACTER)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $ $
DECLARE
    content_safety_score NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    -- Calculate content safety score using various scores from different tables
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(sd.detection_score_profile->>'confval', 0)::NUMERIC * 0.1
        + COALESCE(ma.coordscore, 0) * 0.15
        + COALESCE((nm.network_engagement_metrics->'engagement_metrics'->>'engauth')::NUMERIC, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(cb.cntuniqscore, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(msa.convnatval, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(ti.iprepscore, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE((pr.profile_composition->>'completeness')::NUMERIC, 0) * 0.05
        + COALESCE(ma.trustval, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(ma.impactval, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE((sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore')::NUMERIC, 0) * 0.05
    INTO content_safety_score
    FROM 
        contentbehavior cb
    LEFT JOIN securitydetection sd ON cb.cntref = sd.secdetkey
    LEFT JOIN moderationaction ma ON cb.cntref = ma.macntref
    LEFT JOIN networkmetrics nm ON cb.cntsessref = nm.netsessref
    LEFT JOIN messaginganalysis msa ON cb.cntref = msa.msgcntref
    LEFT JOIN technicalinfo ti ON cb.cntref = ti.techkey
    LEFT JOIN profile pr ON cb.cntref = pr.profkey
    WHERE cb.cntref = p_cntref;

    -- Handle calculation errors
    IF content_safety_score IS NULL THEN
        RAISE WARNING 'Error calculating CSI for %: %', p_cntref, SQLERRM;
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;

    RETURN content_safety_score;
END; $ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_csi(p_cntref CHARACTER)
RETURNS NUMERIC AS $ $
DECLARE
    content_safety_score NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    -- Calculate content safety score using various scores from different tables
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(sd.detection_score_profile->>'confval', 0)::NUMERIC * 0.1
        + COALESCE(ma.coordscore, 0) * 0.15
        + COALESCE((nm.network_engagement_metrics->'engagement_metrics'->>'engauth')::NUMERIC, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(cb.cntuniqscore, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(msa.convnatval, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(ti.iprepscore, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE((pr.profile_composition->>'completeness')::NUMERIC, 0) * 0.05
        + COALESCE(ma.trustval, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE(ma.impactval, 0) * 0.1
        + COALESCE((sd.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore')::NUMERIC, 0) * 0.05
    INTO content_safety_score
    FROM 
        contentbehavior cb
    LEFT JOIN securitydetection sd ON cb.cntref = sd.secdetkey
    LEFT JOIN moderationaction ma ON cb.cntref = ma.macntref
    LEFT JOIN networkmetrics nm ON cb.cntsessref = nm.netsessref
    LEFT JOIN messaginganalysis msa ON cb.cntref = msa.msgcntref
    LEFT JOIN technicalinfo ti ON cb.cntref = ti.techkey
    LEFT JOIN profile pr ON cb.cntref = pr.profkey
    WHERE cb.cntref = p_cntref;

    -- Handle calculation errors
    IF content_safety_score IS NULL THEN
        RAISE WARNING 'Error calculating CSI for %: %', p_cntref, SQLERRM;
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;

    RETURN content_safety_score;
END; $ $ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
